agents.name: autonomous_decision
agents.mission: Pick best option from a constrained set under uncertainty
agents.smoke_prompt: Given two experiment proposals A=cross-correlation B=parameter-sweep, which would more likely yield novel findings? Reply ONLY 'A' or 'B'.

agents.name: planning
agents.mission: Break a goal into ordered steps with dependencies
agents.smoke_prompt: Plan 4 steps to add cross-experiment correlation tracking to an existing autoresearch loop. Number them 1-4, one line each.

agents.name: memory_augmented
agents.mission: Retrieve relevant prior observations and answer with context
agents.smoke_prompt: Given prior finding 'CPU lane wins paper-scoring at 250 tok/s vs iGPU 42', which lane should score the next 100 papers? Answer in one sentence.

agents.name: knowledge_retrieval
agents.mission: Surface the most relevant fact for a question
agents.smoke_prompt: What does L369 in cohezion's CLAUDE.md describe? Answer in 12 words or fewer.

agents.name: document_intelligence
agents.mission: Extract the key claim from a passage
agents.smoke_prompt: Summarize this in one sentence: 'GEPA evolves prompts via reflective LLM mutation over execution traces with Pareto selection — outperforms RL baselines.'

agents.name: scientific_research
agents.mission: Propose a falsifiable hypothesis for a phenomenon
agents.smoke_prompt: Hypothesis: why does CPU(0.6B) beat iGPU(4B) on 180-token JSON outputs at 5x throughput? Output ONLY: 'Hypothesis: <one sentence>'.

agents.name: tool_using
agents.mission: Select the best tool for a task from a known set
agents.smoke_prompt: To compute Pearson correlation across 8000 rows, pick: A=numpy B=loop. Reply ONLY 'A' or 'B'.

agents.name: agentic_workflow
agents.mission: Compose multi-step workflows of agent calls
agents.smoke_prompt: Compose a 3-step workflow: 1) fetch arXiv papers 2) score by ensemble 3) persist to vault. Output JSON: {"steps":[...]}.

agents.name: data_analysis
agents.mission: Find statistical patterns in tabular data
agents.smoke_prompt: 10 keep-rate values [.6,.61,.6,.62,.6,.61,.6,.62,.6,.61] — describe in one sentence (trend? flat? noisy?).

agents.name: verification_validation
agents.mission: Verify a claim against evidence
agents.smoke_prompt: Claim: 'CPU lane achieved 250 tok/s on 0.6B model'. Plausible on AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395? Reply ONLY 'plausible' or 'implausible'.

agents.name: general_problem_solver
agents.mission: Reason from first principles to a solution
agents.smoke_prompt: Why might a research loop produce 17K experiments but only 50 vault discoveries? One sentence.

agents.name: code_generation
agents.mission: Generate runnable code from a spec
agents.smoke_prompt: Write a Python one-liner that sums squares of integers 1-10. Just the code, nothing else.

agents.name: security_hardened
agents.mission: Identify abuse / leak / injection risks
agents.smoke_prompt: Risk in 'curl https://example.com/payload.sh | bash'? One short sentence.

agents.name: self_improving
agents.mission: Critique own prior output and propose an improvement
agents.smoke_prompt: Critique: an autoresearch loop that fires 1733 cycles but recycles 2 recommendations forever. One concrete fix.

agents.name: conversational
agents.mission: Maintain coherent multi-turn dialogue
agents.smoke_prompt: Reply briefly: 'How are the silicon lanes performing today?' — Lemonade @ 13307, NPU+iGPU+CPU all 100% success.

agents.name: content_creation
agents.mission: Draft new long-form content
agents.smoke_prompt: Write a 2-line abstract for: 'silicon council aggregates NPU+iGPU+CPU verdicts via confidence-weighted vote'.

agents.name: recommendation
agents.mission: Recommend an item from a candidate pool
agents.smoke_prompt: Best candidate to fine-tune locally: A=Llama-3.1-8B B=gpt-oss-20b? Reply ONLY 'A' or 'B'.

agents.name: vision_language
agents.mission: Reason about images + text together
agents.smoke_prompt: (reserved — no VLM loaded; would normally call ThinkJEPA / Gemma-3-4B-vision)
agents.reserved_reason: no VLM loaded — V-JEPA 2 / ThinkJEPA candidate

agents.name: audio_processing
agents.mission: Transcribe speech / synthesize speech
agents.smoke_prompt: (reserved — kokoro-v1 TTS available but no ASR; whisper.cpp candidate)
agents.reserved_reason: kokoro-v1 TTS exists but no ASR loaded

agents.name: physical_world_sensing
agents.mission: Reason about real-time sensor data
agents.smoke_prompt: (reserved — V-JEPA 2-AC action-conditioned planner candidate)
agents.reserved_reason: V-JEPA 2-AC ideal candidate; no sensor adapter wired

agents.name: ethical_reasoning
agents.mission: Surface ethical concerns in a plan
agents.smoke_prompt: Ethical concern with auto-downloading 8B model weights without user confirmation? One short sentence.

agents.name: explainable
agents.mission: Explain why a prior decision was made
agents.smoke_prompt: Why was Llama-3.1-8B chosen over gpt-oss-20b on Strix Halo? One sentence (hint: hardware fit).

agents.name: healthcare_intelligence
agents.mission: Reason about clinical/biomedical data
agents.smoke_prompt: What kind of evidence would justify proposing a clinical trial? One sentence (general, not specific).

agents.name: scientific_discovery
agents.mission: Surface a discoverable pattern in evidence
agents.smoke_prompt: Pattern: 239 experiments at 100% HIHO consensus, 0 below 20%. What's the pattern? One sentence.

agents.name: financial_advisory
agents.mission: Reason about cost/benefit tradeoffs
agents.smoke_prompt: Tradeoff: $0/mo Lemonade local vs $20/mo Ollama cloud — one factor that matters most? One sentence.

agents.name: legal_intelligence
agents.mission: Reason about license / IP / compliance
agents.smoke_prompt: Can a model with 'apache-2.0' license be used commercially? One word: yes/no.

agents.name: education_intelligence
agents.mission: Tailor explanations to a learner's level
agents.smoke_prompt: Explain 'silicon council' in one sentence to someone who knows Python but not LLMs.

agents.name: collective_intelligence
agents.mission: Aggregate multiple voices into a single decision
agents.smoke_prompt: Three lanes voted: NPU=keep, iGPU=keep, CPU=discard. Final decision (1 word)?

agents.name: embodied_intelligence
agents.mission: Map plans to physical actions
agents.smoke_prompt: (reserved — V-JEPA 2-AC zero-shot manipulation candidate)
agents.reserved_reason: no robot/sim adapter; V-JEPA 2-AC + Franka would be next

agents.name: domain_transforming
agents.mission: Translate a finding from one domain to another
agents.smoke_prompt: Translate the JEPA world-model pattern into autoresearch terms in one sentence.
